# hivelocity_bare_metal_device (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_bare_metal_device" "mine" {
  first = true

  filter {
    name   = "hostname"
    values = ["webserver.terraform.test"]
  }
}

output "my_bare_metal" {
  value = data.hivelocity_bare_metal_device.mine
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (Number)
- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.
- `hostname` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `location_name` (String)
- `order_id` (Number)
- `os_name` (String)
- `period` (String)
- `power_status` (String)
- `primary_ip` (String)
- `product_id` (Number)
- `product_name` (String)
- `public_ssh_key_id` (Number)
- `script` (String)
- `service_id` (Number)
- `tags` (List of String)
- `vlan_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
